snippet.title: Ninja Jajamaru: Yokai Night Parade – Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Get ready for a Throwdown, all the way in Yokai Town! 

The 80s Arcade Icon, still faces his enemies Head-On!

Come to the Princess’ Aid in Ninja Jajamaru: Yokai Night Parade

Ninja Jajamaru will be coming to PS5, Nintendo Switch 2 and Steam. 

Wishlist Now on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4173010/
